About one in eight, 12.2%, said he may use force [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. The share of men who rejected every coercive response on the survey's list fell from 77% in NFHS-4 to 72% [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

On force, those men are not contradicting the statute book. Exception 2 to Section 63 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita still says sexual acts by a man with his own wife, if she is 18 or older, are not rape [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. A constitutional challenge to that exception is still pending in the Supreme Court.

More than a third of men, 35.1%, agreed that "contraception is women's business and a man should not have to worry about it". Another 19.6% agreed that women who use contraception may become promiscuous [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

The first belief shows up in what couples actually use. Female sterilisation was the method of 37.9% of currently married women. Male sterilisation was used by 0.3% [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. An opinion recorded in one chapter of the survey turns up in another as an operation, almost always on the woman.

## HIV: fear in place of facts

The survey also tests two old fears. In 2019-21, 46% of women aged 15-49 did not know that HIV cannot be transmitted by mosquito bites, and 55% did not know it cannot spread by sharing food with a person who has AIDS. Those shares include women who answered wrongly and women who said they did not know. Among men, 64% and 59% knew the right answers [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Only 22% of women and 31% of men had what the survey calls comprehensive knowledge of HIV [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

A food myth is not harmless. It decides who may eat with the family, who keeps a job in a kitchen and who is asked to vacate a rented room. The law has an answer: Section 3 of the HIV and AIDS (Prevention and Control) Act, 2017 bars discrimination against people living with HIV in employment, healthcare, education and housing [[naco-hiv-aids-act-2017-gazette]]. Medicine has one too: a person on treatment whose virus is undetectable does not pass HIV on through sex [[who-hiv]].

## Sons, and what is changing

For son preference, the clearest figure comes from a different, older survey, so do not read it on the same line as NFHS-5. In 2014, ICRW and UNFPA surveyed 9,205 men and 3,158 women in seven states. Asked about sons, 76% of men and 81% of women said it was very important to have at least one [[icrw-unfpa-masculinity-ipv-son-preference-2014]]. Again, women were ahead of men.

Birth records suggest this belief is slowly losing ground. India's sex ratio at birth crept up from 904 girls per 1,000 boys in 2017-19 to 917 in 2021-23 [[srs-statistical-report-2023]], and 918 in 2022-24 [[srs-statistical-report-2024]]. That is movement, not balance: the ratio is still below the natural level.

So the scorecard is mixed. Retreating: women's acceptance of wife-beating, and the gap at birth. Not retreating: men's acceptance of wife-beating, and men's rejection of coercion in bed, which weakened. Time alone does not retire a myth.

Each survey round repeats the same questions. The answers change in between, in smaller rooms: when a man buys the condoms and goes to the clinic too, when a family eats with a relative who has HIV, when someone says a wife who answered back "had it coming" and another person at the table says no.
india-myth-census-nfhs-beliefs.hg:
Myth sunne mein aisi cheez lagti hai jise gina nahi ja sakta: shaadi mein kisi uncle ki kahi hui baat, family WhatsApp group ka koi forward. Lekin India apne myths ginta hai: National Family Health Survey adults se poochta hai ki woh kya maante hain. Iske paanchve round, NFHS-5 (2019-21) mein, 15-49 saal ke 44% mardon ne kaha ki saat mein se kam se kam ek situation mein pati ka apni wife ko maarna jaayaz hai. 45% auraton ne bhi yahi kaha [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

## Survey myth ko kaise naapta hai

Survey logon se yeh nahi poochta ki woh aam taur par violence ko support karte hain ya nahi. Woh ek situation batata hai aur us par faisla maangta hai. Agar wife apne sasuraal walon ki izzat na kare, toh kya pati ka use maarna-peetna jaayaz hai? Agar woh sex se mana kare, toh? Aisi saat situations hain, aur jo ek par bhi "haan" kehta hai, woh ginti mein aa jaata hai [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Us interview ko imagine kijiye. Ek chhote sheher mein 28 saal ka ek aadmi ek ajnabi ke saamne baitha hai, jiske haath mein questionnaire hai, aur poori list ke sawaal ek-ek karke pooche ja rahe hain. Koi yeh check nahi karta ki woh asal mein kaise jeeta hai. Survey bas woh record karta hai jo woh zor se kehne ko tayyar hai.

Isliye do baatein dhyaan mein rakhiye. Yeh figures attitudes hain, violence ki ginti nahi. Aur yeh ek ajnabi ko diye gaye jawab hain, isliye har number ko un logon ka hissa samajhna behtar hai jo ek belief ko kabool karte hain, na ki un sabka jo use maante hain.

## Shaadi aur violence: mard aur auratein kya jaayaz maante hain

| Sawaal | Mard | Auratein |
|---|---|---|
| Saat mein se kam se kam ek situation mein pati ka wife ko maarna jaayaz | 44% | 45% |
| Jaayaz, agar woh sasuraal walon ki izzat na kare | 31% | 32% |
| Jaayaz, agar woh sex se mana kare | 10% | 11% |
| Jaante hain ki HIV saath khaana khaane se nahi phailta | 59% | 45% |
| Kam se kam ek beta hona bahut zaroori (2014, saat states) | 76% | 81% |

Sasuraal walon ki "beizzati" woh wajah thi jise sabse zyada logon ne jaayaz maana, aur sex se mana karna sabse kam [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Ab dono columns ko compare kijiye. Shaadi wali har row mein auratein kam se kam utni hi baar "haan" kehti hain jitne mard. Yeh sirf "mardon ki soch" nahi hai. Yeh ek aisa norm hai jise bahut si auraton ne bhi apna liya hai.

Map bhi aam stereotypes ke hisaab se nahi chalta. Auraton mein, Andhra Pradesh aur Telangana mein 84% aur Tamil Nadu mein 78% ne kaha ki wife ko maarna jaayaz ho sakta hai. Mardon mein yeh figure Karnataka mein 82% tak pahuncha [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Trend gender ke hisaab se alag-alag hai. Auraton ki sehmati NFHS-4 (2015-16) ke 52% se girkar 45% ho gayi. Mardon ki badh gayi, 42% se 44% [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

## Contraception aur sex: gender ka gap

Mardon se yeh bhi poocha gaya ki agar wife sex se mana kare, toh pati ko kya karne ka haq hai. Lagbhag paanch mein se ek, 19.2%, ne kaha ki woh gussa ho sakta hai aur use daant sakta hai. Lagbhag aath mein se ek, 12.2%, ne kaha ki woh zabardasti kar sakta hai [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Survey ki list ke har coercive response ko reject karne wale mardon ka hissa NFHS-4 ke 77% se girkar 72% reh gaya [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Zabardasti wale sawaal par yeh mard kanoon ki kitaab ke khilaf nahi bol rahe. Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita ki Section 63 ka Exception 2 aaj bhi kehta hai ki apni wife ke saath, agar woh 18 saal ya usse badi hai, mard ke sexual acts rape nahi hain [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Is exception ke khilaf constitutional challenge abhi bhi Supreme Court mein pending hai.

Ek-tihaai se zyada mard, 35.1%, is baat se sehmat the ki "contraception auraton ka kaam hai aur mard ko iski chinta nahi karni chahiye". Aur 19.6% is baat se sehmat the ki contraception use karne wali auratein "promiscuous" ho sakti hain [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Pehla belief is baat mein dikhta hai ki couples asal mein kya use karte hain. 37.9% currently married auraton ka method female sterilisation tha. Male sterilisation sirf 0.3% ne use kiya [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Survey ke ek chapter mein record hui raay doosre chapter mein ek operation bankar dikhti hai, aur woh operation lagbhag hamesha aurat ka hota hai.

## HIV: facts ki jagah darr

Survey do purane darr bhi test karta hai. 2019-21 mein 15-49 saal ki 46% auraton ko nahi pata tha ki HIV machhar ke kaatne se nahi phailta, aur 55% ko nahi pata tha ki yeh AIDS wale insaan ke saath khaana share karne se nahi phailta. In hisson mein woh auratein bhi hain jinhone galat jawab diya aur woh bhi jinhone kaha ki unhe pata nahi. Mardon mein 64% aur 59% ko sahi jawab pata the [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Sirf 22% auraton aur 31% mardon ke paas woh thi jise survey HIV ki "comprehensive knowledge" kehta hai [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Khaane wala myth harmless nahi hai. Yahi tay karta hai ki parivaar ke saath kaun kha sakta hai, kitchen ki naukri kiski bachti hai aur kisse kiraye ka kamra khaali karne ko kaha jaata hai. Law ke paas iska jawab hai: HIV and AIDS (Prevention and Control) Act, 2017 ki Section 3 HIV ke saath jee rahe logon ke khilaf employment, healthcare, education aur housing mein discrimination par rok lagati hai [[naco-hiv-aids-act-2017-gazette]]. Medicine ke paas bhi jawab hai: jo insaan treatment par hai aur jiska virus undetectable hai, usse sex ke zariye HIV aage nahi phailta [[who-hiv]].

## Bete, aur kya badal raha hai

Son preference ka sabse saaf figure ek alag aur purane survey se aata hai, isliye use NFHS-5 wali line mein rakhkar mat padhiye. 2014 mein ICRW aur UNFPA ne saat states mein 9,205 mardon aur 3,158 auraton ka survey kiya. Beton ke baare mein poochne par 76% mardon aur 81% auraton ne kaha ki kam se kam ek beta hona bahut zaroori hai [[icrw-unfpa-masculinity-ipv-son-preference-2014]]. Yahan bhi auratein mardon se aage thin.

Birth records batate hain ki yeh belief dheere-dheere zameen kho raha hai. India ka sex ratio at birth 2017-19 ke 904 ladkiyan per 1,000 ladke se badhkar 2021-23 mein 917 hua [[srs-statistical-report-2023]], aur 2022-24 mein 918 [[srs-statistical-report-2024]]. Yeh sudhaar hai, barabari nahi: ratio abhi bhi natural level se neeche hai.

Toh scorecard mila-jula hai. Peeche hat rahe hain: auraton mein wife-beating ka acceptance, aur birth ke samay ka gap. Peeche nahi hat rahe: mardon mein wife-beating ka acceptance, aur bistar mein zabardasti ko reject karne wale mard, jinka hissa aur kam hua. Sirf waqt beetne se koi myth retire nahi hota.

Survey ka har round wahi sawaal dohrata hai. Jawab do rounds ke beech badalte hain, chhote kamron mein: jab mard condom khud khareedta hai aur clinic bhi saath jaata hai, jab parivaar HIV wale rishtedaar ke saath baithkar khaana khaata hai, jab koi kehta hai ki palatkar jawab dene wali wife ke saath "theek hi hua" aur usi table par baitha koi doosra kehta hai: nahi.

its-our-tradition-dowry-child-marriage-k.en:
"Hamare yahan aisa hi hota hai." This is how it is done in our family. Many Indians have heard it from an elder, usually just as a younger person starts asking questions. It sounds like an answer and works as a full stop. The daughter who objects to the dowry list, the early wedding or the cut is no longer questioning a practice. She is told she is insulting her grandparents.

Three practices lean on that sentence more than most: dowry, child marriage and khatna, the cutting of girls' genitals. The law and the evidence are against all three. Each survives because it is defended as culture, as love or as protection.

## The argument that ends arguments

"Tradition" is a statement about the past. It says nothing about whether a practice hurts someone today. What it does is move the conversation from "what does this do to her?" to "who are you to question us?"

It also hides who pays. In all three practices the cost lands on a girl or a young woman, and the decision is taken by adults who will not bear it.

When the defence is challenged, the names change. Dowry becomes "gifts". A child's wedding becomes "settling her safely". Cutting becomes "only a small nick". Each new name admits that the old one could not be defended.

## Dowry: a 'gift' that is a crime

Dowry has been illegal since the Dowry Prohibition Act of 1961. Giving, taking or abetting dowry carries at least five years in prison and a fine of at least Rs 15,000 or the value of the dowry, whichever is more; demanding it carries six months to two years [[indiacode-dowry-prohibition-1961]]. The law punishes the giver as well, so calling it a "gift" suits both families. This is general information, not legal advice.

The custom has outlived the ban. In 2024 police registered 12,343 cases under the Act, and 5,737 dowry deaths with 5,811 victims, about 16 a day [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Courts convicted in only 17.4% of the Dowry Prohibition Act trials they decided that year, and 83,298 cases were still pending [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Those are only the cases that reached a police station. Behind them sits the idea that a daughter is a liability, handed over with a payment. The car, the gold and "give whatever you wish to your own daughter" are the same demand in politer words.

## Child marriage: 'protection' that harms

Early marriage is defended as protection: from gossip, from poverty, from a bigger dowry later. That last reason is real. UNFPA notes that where the bride's family pays dowry, younger brides typically command smaller dowries, which gives poor parents an incentive to marry daughters off early [[unfpa-child-marriage-2025]]. One tradition feeds the other.

What the girl receives is not safety. UNICEF says girls who marry before 18 are more likely to experience domestic violence and less likely to stay in school [[unicef-child-marriage-topic-page]]. The Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006 covers any marriage where the bride is under 18 or the groom under 21; an adult man who marries a child, or anyone who performs or abets the wedding, faces up to two years' rigorous imprisonment [[indiacode-pcma-2006]]. In 2017 the Supreme Court held that sex with a wife under 18 is rape [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]].

Imagine a 16-year-old in a small town in Bihar, pulled out of Class 11 because a "good proposal" has come and the boy's family is asking for little. Every adult in the room believes they are protecting her. None of them is the one who will leave school and move into a house of strangers.

## Khatna: a 'small' cut that is not

Khatna is the female genital cutting practised in the Dawoodi Bohra community [[scobserver-sunita-tiwari-fgm-case]]. It is done to children, and defended as faith and as too minor to matter. At a Supreme Court hearing on 7 May 2026, counsel for the review petitioners called it "a symbolic form of circumcision"; Justice Joymalya Bagchi replied that male circumcision could not be equated with genital cutting involving the clitoris [[scobserver-sabarimala-day13-2026]]. A remark in a hearing is not a ruling. That nine-judge bench was hearing a wider reference on religious practices whose outcome will shape the khatna case; it reserved judgment on 14 May 2026 [[scobserver-sabarimala-day16-2026]]. Meanwhile no specific Indian law bans the practice [[scobserver-sabarimala-day13-2026]].

The government's own position is on record. In 2018 the Attorney General told the Supreme Court that the Union government opposed khatna as a violation of fundamental rights [[toi-fgm-five-judge-bench-2018]]. UNFPA says female genital mutilation is documented in at least 94 countries, India among them [[unfpa-fgm-faq-2026]]. WHO says it has no health benefits and opposes every form of it, including when a health worker does the cutting [[who-fgm]].

Whatever the court decides about faith, the facts about the child stay the same. She cannot consent, and she gains nothing medically.

## How traditions actually change

The best reply to "it has always been this way" is that it has not. In 2005-06, 47.4% of Indian women aged 20-24 had been married before 18. The figure was 26.8% in 2015-16, 23.3% in 2019-21 and 20.1% in 2023-24 [[ceda-genderstats-underage-marriage-2021]]. A custom described as eternal lost more than half its hold in under two decades. One in five is still too many, but the practice is plainly not unchangeable.

Change also comes from inside. In an online survey by Sahiyo, a group of Dawoodi Bohra women campaigning against khatna, 80% of 385 Bohra women respondents said they had undergone it, and 82% said they were unlikely to continue it on their daughters [[sahiyo-khatna-survey-2017]]. The sample was small and self-selected, so it cannot tell us how common khatna is. What it shows is women of the community, not outsiders, deciding that the practice stops with them.

If "tradition" is being used to silence you or your daughter, go back to the question it avoids: who is protected by this, and who pays? A girl being pushed into marriage before 18 can call the Child Helpline on 1098; a woman facing dowry threats can call 112. A tradition is a habit that enough people repeat. It ends the same way it lasted: one family at a time.
its-our-tradition-dowry-child-marriage-k.hg:
"Hamare yahan aisa hi hota hai." Yeh line bahut se Indians ne kisi bade se suni hai, aksar theek us waqt jab ghar ka koi chhota sawaal poochna shuru karta hai. Sunne mein yeh jawaab lagta hai, par kaam full stop ka karta hai. Jo beti dahej ki list, jaldi shaadi ya "cut" par aitraaz karti hai, woh ab kisi practice par sawaal nahi kar rahi. Use bataya jaata hai ki woh apne dada-dadi ki beizzati kar rahi hai.

Teen practices is line ka sahara sabse zyada leti hain: dahej, child marriage aur khatna, yaani bachchiyon ke genitals ko kaatna. Law aur evidence teeno ke khilaf hain. Phir bhi teeno zinda hain, kyunki inhe culture, pyaar ya hifazat ka naam de kar defend kiya jaata hai.

## Woh daleel jo har behas khatam kar deti hai

"Parampara" beete hue kal ke baare mein ek baat hai. Yeh nahi batati ki koi practice aaj kisi ko chot pahunchati hai ya nahi. Yeh bas baat-cheet ko "isse us ladki par kya guzarti hai?" se hata kar "tum kaun hote ho hum par sawaal uthane wale?" par le aati hai.

Yeh line yeh bhi chhupa deti hai ki keemat kaun chukata hai. Teeno practices mein nuksaan ek ladki ya jawaan aurat ka hota hai, aur faisla woh bade lete hain jinhe yeh nuksaan khud nahi jhelna.

Jab is daleel ko challenge kiya jaata hai, toh naam badal jaate hain. Dahej "gifts" ban jaata hai. Bachchi ki shaadi "use theek se settle karna" ban jaati hai. Kaatna "bas ek chhota sa nick" ban jaata hai. Har naya naam yeh maan leta hai ki purana naam defend nahi ho sakta tha.

## Dahej: woh 'gift' jo crime hai

Dahej 1961 ke Dowry Prohibition Act se hi illegal hai. Dahej dene, lene ya ismein madad karne par kam se kam paanch saal ki jail hai, aur saath mein kam se kam Rs 15,000 ya dahej ki value ke barabar fine, jo bhi zyada ho. Dahej maangne par chhe mahine se do saal ki jail hai [[indiacode-dowry-prohibition-1961]]. Law dene wale ko bhi saza deta hai, isliye ise "gift" kehna dono families ke liye suvidha ki baat hai. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

Ban ke baad bhi yeh riwaaz chalta raha. 2024 mein police ne is Act ke under 12,343 cases register kiye, aur 5,737 dowry deaths, jinmein 5,811 victims the, yaani roz kareeb 16 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Us saal courts ne Dowry Prohibition Act ke jin trials ka faisla kiya, unmein se sirf 17.4% mein conviction hui, aur 83,298 cases ab bhi pending the [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Yeh sirf woh cases hain jo police station tak pahunche. Inke peeche yeh soch hai ki beti ek bojh hai, jise payment ke saath aage saunp diya jaata hai. Gaadi, sona aur "apni beti ko jo dena chahein, de dijiye", yeh sab wahi demand hai, bas zyada tameez wale shabdon mein.

## Child marriage: woh 'hifazat' jo nuksaan karti hai

Jaldi shaadi ko hifazat keh kar defend kiya jaata hai: logon ki baaton se, gareebi se, baad mein badhne wale dahej se. Yeh aakhri wajah sach hai. UNFPA ke mutabik jahan ladki ki family dahej deti hai, wahan kam umar ki dulhan par aam taur par kam dahej lagta hai, aur isse gareeb maa-baap ko betiyon ki shaadi jaldi karne ka incentive milta hai [[unfpa-child-marriage-2025]]. Ek parampara doosri ko paalti hai.

Ladki ko jo milta hai, woh safety nahi hai. UNICEF kehta hai ki jin ladkiyon ki shaadi 18 se pehle hoti hai, unke saath domestic violence hone ka chance zyada hota hai aur school mein bane rehne ka chance kam [[unicef-child-marriage-topic-page]]. Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006 har us shaadi par lagta hai jismein dulhan 18 se kam ya dulha 21 se kam ho. Jo adult aadmi bachchi se shaadi karta hai, ya jo bhi aisi shaadi karwata hai ya ismein madad karta hai, use do saal tak ki rigorous imprisonment ho sakti hai [[indiacode-pcma-2006]]. 2017 mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki 18 se kam umar ki wife ke saath sex rape hai [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]].

Imagine kijiye Bihar ke ek chhote sheher ki 16 saal ki ladki ko. Use Class 11 se nikaal liya gaya hai, kyunki ek "achha rishta" aaya hai aur ladke wale kam maang rahe hain. Kamre mein baitha har bada maanta hai ki woh uski hifazat kar raha hai. Par school chhod kar anjaan logon ke ghar jaana unmein se kisi ko nahi hai.

## Khatna: woh 'chhota' cut jo chhota nahi hai

Khatna woh female genital cutting hai jo Dawoodi Bohra community mein ki jaati hai [[scobserver-sunita-tiwari-fgm-case]]. Yeh bachchiyon ke saath hota hai, aur ise aastha keh kar aur "itni chhoti si baat" keh kar defend kiya jaata hai. 7 May 2026 ko Supreme Court ki hearing mein review petitioners ke vakeel ne ise "a symbolic form of circumcision" kaha, yaani circumcision ka bas ek symbolic roop. Justice Joymalya Bagchi ne jawaab diya ki male circumcision ko us genital cutting ke barabar nahi rakha ja sakta jismein clitoris shaamil ho [[scobserver-sabarimala-day13-2026]]. Hearing mein kahi gayi baat faisla nahi hoti. Nau judges ki yeh bench religious practices par ek badi reference sun rahi thi, jiska nateeja khatna case ki disha tay karega; usne 14 May 2026 ko judgment reserve kar liya [[scobserver-sabarimala-day16-2026]]. Tab tak India mein aisa koi specific law nahi hai jo is practice ko ban karta ho [[scobserver-sabarimala-day13-2026]].

Government ka apna stand record par hai. 2018 mein Attorney General ne Supreme Court ko bataya ki Union government khatna ke khilaf hai, kyunki yeh fundamental rights ka violation hai [[toi-fgm-five-judge-bench-2018]]. UNFPA ke mutabik female genital mutilation kam se kam 94 countries mein documented hai, aur India unmein se ek hai [[unfpa-fgm-faq-2026]]. WHO kehta hai ki iska koi health benefit nahi hai, aur woh iske har roop ka virodh karta hai, tab bhi jab cutting koi health worker kare [[who-fgm]].

Court aastha ke baare mein jo bhi faisla de, bachchi ke baare mein facts wahi rahenge. Woh consent nahi de sakti, aur medically use kuch nahi milta.

## Paramparayein asal mein kaise badalti hain

"Hamesha se aisa hi hota aaya hai" ka sabse achha jawaab yeh hai ki aisa nahi hai. 2005-06 mein 20-24 saal ki 47.4% Indian women ki shaadi 18 se pehle ho chuki thi. 2015-16 mein yeh figure 26.8% tha, 2019-21 mein 23.3% aur 2023-24 mein 20.1% [[ceda-genderstats-underage-marriage-2021]]. Jis riwaaz ko "hamesha ka" kaha jaata tha, uski pakad do dashak se kam mein aadhe se zyada dheeli ho gayi. Paanch mein se ek ab bhi bahut zyada hai, par yeh saaf hai ki yeh practice badal sakti hai.

Badlaav andar se bhi aata hai. Sahiyo khatna ke khilaf campaign karne wali Dawoodi Bohra women ka group hai. Uske ek online survey mein 385 Bohra women respondents mein se 80% ne kaha ki unka khatna hua tha, aur 82% ne kaha ki woh apni betiyon par ise shayad hi continue karengi [[sahiyo-khatna-survey-2017]]. Sample chhota tha aur self-selected tha, isliye isse yeh pata nahi chalta ki khatna kitna common hai. Isse yeh zaroor dikhta hai ki bahar wale nahi, community ki apni aurtein tay kar rahi hain ki yeh practice un par aa kar ruk jayegi.

Agar "parampara" ka istemaal aapko ya aapki beti ko chup karane ke liye ho raha hai, toh usi sawaal par lautiye jisse yeh line bachti hai: isse kiski hifazat hoti hai, aur keemat kaun chukata hai? Jis ladki par 18 se pehle shaadi ka pressure hai, woh Child Helpline 1098 par call kar sakti hai. Jis aurat ko dahej ke liye dhamkaya ja raha hai, woh 112 par call kar sakti hai. Parampara bas ek aadat hai jise kaafi log dohrate rehte hain. Yeh khatam bhi waise hi hoti hai jaise chalti rahi: ek-ek family karke.

marriage-not-consent-law-admits.en:
Imagine a 26-year-old in Indore, four years into her marriage, who tells her husband "not tonight". Many Indians would say she gave up that right at her wedding. In NFHS-5 (2019-21), 12.2% of Indian men aged 15-49 said a husband has the right to use force to have sex if his wife refuses [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. One line of Indian criminal law still agrees with them. At least three other parts of Indian law already do not.

## The myth of the lifetime yes

The myth says a wedding is one permanent yes: to every act, every night, for life.

It is not dying out. The share of men who rejected all four coercive responses to a wife refusing sex, from anger to force, fell from 77% in NFHS-4 (2015-16) to 72% in NFHS-5 [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. And it is not just talk: 4.6% of ever-married women aged 18-49 said their husband had physically forced them to have intercourse [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

The law's own definition of consent leaves no room for a lifetime yes. Section 63 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) defines consent as an "unequivocal voluntary agreement" to "the specific sexual act" [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. A yes to one act, on one night, cannot be signed once for decades.

## Exception 2 and the government's 2024 position

Then, in the same section, comes Exception 2: "Sexual intercourse or sexual acts by a man with his own wife, the wife not being under eighteen years of age, is not rape." [[indiacode-bns-2023]] It was carried over from Section 375 of the Indian Penal Code, which the BNS replaced on 1 July 2024. Forced sex by a husband on an adult wife is still not rape in Indian criminal law. In January 2013 the Justice J.S. Verma Committee recommended deleting the exception; Parliament kept it anyway [[thehindu-verma-2013]].

In an affidavit verified on 3 October 2024, the Union government told the Supreme Court that marital rape is "more of a social issue rather than a legal issue" and that calling it rape could be "excessively harsh and therefore, disproportionate" [[union-counter-affidavit-marital-rape-2024]]. Yet the same affidavit concedes the central point: "a husband certainly does not have any fundamental right to violate the consent of the wife" [[union-counter-affidavit-marital-rape-2024]]. The government's objection is to the word "rape", not to the idea that a wife can refuse.

The UN committee on women's rights, CEDAW, asked India to make marital rape a crime in 2007 and 2014 [[cedaw-india-concluding-observations-2014]], and asked again in February 2026 [[cedaw-india-loipr-2026]].

## Three places the law already says marriage is not consent

**When she lives apart.** Section 67 of the BNS punishes a husband who has sex with his wife without her consent while they live separately with 2 to 7 years in prison [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. The law accepts that a wife's no matters. It just protects that no only after she leaves home, and less than any other woman's: the minimum sentence for rape is 10 years.

**When she is under 18.** On 11 October 2017, in Independent Thought v. Union of India, the Supreme Court read down the exception so that sex with a wife under 18 is rape [[sc-independent-thought-2017]]. It expressly left the question of adult wives for another day.

**When forced sex leads to pregnancy.** On 29 September 2022 the Supreme Court held that "rape" in the abortion law, the MTP Act, includes marital rape. A wife pregnant from forced sex by her husband can seek an abortion up to 24 weeks as a rape survivor, with no FIR and no proof in court [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]]. Our story on that ruling explains how.

If marriage were consent for life, none of these rules could exist. Exception 2 is the one place where the law refuses to name what happens when a wife's no is ignored.

## The challenge before the Supreme Court

The high courts have split. On 11 May 2022, in RIT Foundation v. Union of India, the Delhi High Court delivered a split verdict: Justice Rajiv Shakdher struck the exception down and Justice C. Hari Shankar upheld it [[scconline-rit-foundation-split-verdict-2022]]. In March 2022 the Karnataka High Court held that the exception is not absolute and let a rape charge against a husband go ahead. The Supreme Court stayed that ruling in July 2022, and his appeal is now the lead case [[indianexpress-marital-rape-final-hearing-2026]].

A fresh petition against Exception 2 to Section 63 of the BNS, Aweksha Women's Charitable Trust v. Union of India, was filed on 24 April 2025. The court issued notice on 23 May 2025 and tagged it with the pending cases [[clpr-aweksha-v-union-2025]].

On 9 September 2026 a bench of Chief Justice Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V. Mohana posted the cases for final hearing. It said it would decide both whether the exception is valid and whether a husband can be prosecuted while it stands [[livelaw-marital-rape-final-hearing-2026]]. As of 19 November 2026 there was still no ruling, and the bench said it would fix the hearing on 9 or 10 December 2026 [[lawbeat-marital-rape-hearing-2026]].

At its core, the question is this: can the law deny a woman the protection every other woman has, only because she is married?

## Consent inside a marriage, in practice

Consent in a marriage works the way it works anywhere else. It is asked for, not assumed. It covers this act, now. It can change. "Not tonight" needs no reason, and a reluctant "okay" after sulking, threats or lectures about duty is not an "unequivocal voluntary agreement".

Until the Supreme Court rules, a wife still has options. The Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 counts "sexual abuse", any sexual conduct that abuses, humiliates, degrades or violates a woman's dignity, as domestic violence [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]]. It is mainly a civil law: a magistrate can order protection, residence and maintenance.

A wedding is a promise to share a life. It is not a signature on every night that follows.

This is general information, not legal advice.
marriage-not-consent-law-admits.hg:
Sochiye, Indore ki ek 26 saal ki aurat hai, shaadi ko chaar saal ho gaye hain, aur ek raat woh pati se kehti hai "aaj nahi". Bahut se log kahenge ki yeh haq toh usne shaadi ke din hi chhod diya tha. NFHS-5 (2019-21) mein 15-49 saal ke 12.2% Indian mardon ne kaha ki agar wife mana kare, toh pati ko zabardasti sex karne ka haq hai [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Indian criminal law ki ek line aaj bhi inhi ki baat dohraati hai. Lekin law ke kam se kam teen doosre hisse aisa nahi maante.

## 'Hamesha ki haan' wala myth

Yeh myth kehta hai ki shaadi ek permanent haan hai: har act ke liye, har raat ke liye, poori zindagi ke liye.

Yeh soch apne aap khatam nahi ho rahi. Wife ke mana karne par gussa karne se lekar zabardasti tak, aise chaaron coercive responses ko galat maanne wale mard NFHS-4 (2015-16) mein 77% the, aur NFHS-5 mein ghatkar 72% reh gaye [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Aur yeh sirf baatein nahi hain: 18-49 saal ki 4.6% shaadishuda aurton ne bataya ki pati ne physically force karke unke saath sex kiya [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Law ki apni definition mein "hamesha ki haan" ki koi jagah nahi hai. Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ki Section 63 consent ko "unequivocal voluntary agreement" kehti hai, yaani saaf aur apni marzi se di gayi haan, aur woh bhi "the specific sexual act" ke liye [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Ek act, ek raat ki haan par dashakon ke liye ek baar mein sign nahi karaya ja sakta.

## Exception 2 aur 2024 mein sarkar ka stand

Phir usi section mein aata hai Exception 2: "Sexual intercourse or sexual acts by a man with his own wife, the wife not being under eighteen years of age, is not rape." [[indiacode-bns-2023]] Yeh line Indian Penal Code ki Section 375 se uthayi gayi hai, jiski jagah 1 July 2024 ko BNS ne le li. Matlab aaj bhi adult wife ke saath pati ki zabardasti Indian criminal law mein rape nahi hai. January 2013 mein Justice J.S. Verma Committee ne yeh exception hatane ki salah di thi; phir bhi Parliament ne use rakha [[thehindu-verma-2013]].

3 October 2024 ke ek affidavit mein Union government ne Supreme Court se kaha ki marital rape "more of a social issue rather than a legal issue" hai, aur ise rape kehna "excessively harsh and therefore, disproportionate" ho sakta hai [[union-counter-affidavit-marital-rape-2024]]. Lekin usi affidavit mein sarkar asli baat maan bhi leti hai: "a husband certainly does not have any fundamental right to violate the consent of the wife" [[union-counter-affidavit-marital-rape-2024]]. Yaani sarkar ko "rape" shabd se dikkat hai, is baat se nahi ki wife mana kar sakti hai.

UN ki women's rights committee, CEDAW, ne 2007 aur 2014 mein India se kaha ki marital rape ko crime banaya jaaye [[cedaw-india-concluding-observations-2014]], aur February 2026 mein phir yahi poochha [[cedaw-india-loipr-2026]].

## Teen jagah jahan law khud maanta hai ki shaadi consent nahi hai

**Jab wife alag rehti ho.** BNS ki Section 67 ke hisaab se agar pati-patni alag reh rahe hain aur pati uske consent ke bina sex karta hai, toh use 2 se 7 saal ki jail hogi [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Matlab law maanta hai ki wife ki "na" matter karti hai. Bas woh is "na" ko tab bachata hai jab wife ghar chhod de, aur woh bhi kisi aur aurat se kam: rape ki minimum saza 10 saal hai.

**Jab wife 18 se kam ki ho.** 11 October 2017 ko Independent Thought v. Union of India case mein Supreme Court ne exception ko chhota kar diya, taaki 18 se kam umar ki wife ke saath sex rape maana jaaye [[sc-independent-thought-2017]]. Adult wives ka sawaal court ne jaan-boojhkar kisi aur din ke liye chhod diya.

**Jab zabardasti se pregnancy ho jaaye.** 29 September 2022 ko Supreme Court ne kaha ki abortion law, yaani MTP Act, mein "rape" ke andar marital rape bhi aata hai. Pati ki zabardasti se pregnant hui wife rape survivor ki tarah 24 hafte tak abortion kara sakti hai, na FIR chahiye na court mein kuch saabit karna [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]]. Is ruling ko kaise use karein, yeh hamari alag story mein hai.

Agar shaadi sach mein hamesha ki haan hoti, toh inmein se koi rule ban hi nahi sakta tha. Exception 2 akeli jagah hai jahan law wife ki "na" ko ignore karne wale kaam ko uska asli naam dene se inkaar karta hai.

## Supreme Court ke saamne challenge

High courts is par bante hue hain. 11 May 2022 ko RIT Foundation v. Union of India mein Delhi High Court ka split verdict aaya: Justice Rajiv Shakdher ne exception ko strike down kiya, aur Justice C. Hari Shankar ne use sahi thehraya [[scconline-rit-foundation-split-verdict-2022]]. March 2022 mein Karnataka High Court ne kaha ki yeh exception absolute nahi hai, aur ek pati par rape charge chalne diya. July 2022 mein Supreme Court ne us ruling par rok laga di, aur ab usi pati ki appeal lead case hai [[indianexpress-marital-rape-final-hearing-2026]].

BNS ki Section 63 ke Exception 2 ke khilaaf ek nayi petition, Aweksha Women's Charitable Trust v. Union of India, 24 April 2025 ko file hui. Court ne 23 May 2025 ko notice issue kiya aur ise baaki pending cases ke saath jod diya [[clpr-aweksha-v-union-2025]].

9 September 2026 ko Chief Justice Surya Kant, Justice Joymalya Bagchi aur Justice V. Mohana ki bench ne in cases ko final hearing ke liye list kiya. Bench ne kaha ki woh do baatein decide karegi: exception valid hai ya nahi, aur jab tak exception hai, kya pati par prosecution chal sakta hai [[livelaw-marital-rape-final-hearing-2026]]. 19 November 2026 tak koi faisla nahi aaya tha, aur bench ne kaha ki hearing 9 ya 10 December 2026 ko fix karegi [[lawbeat-marital-rape-hearing-2026]].

Asli sawaal bas itna hai: kya law kisi aurat se woh protection sirf isliye chheen sakta hai ki woh shaadishuda hai, jo baaki har aurat ko milti hai?

## Shaadi ke andar consent, asli zindagi mein

Shaadi mein consent waise hi kaam karta hai jaise kahin aur. Use poochha jaata hai, maan nahi liya jaata. Woh is act ke liye hai, abhi ke liye. Woh badal bhi sakta hai. "Aaj nahi" bolne ke liye koi wajah nahi chahiye, aur roothne, dhamkane ya "wife ka farz" wale lecture ke baad majboori mein nikla "theek hai" koi "unequivocal voluntary agreement" nahi hai.

Jab tak Supreme Court faisla nahi deta, tab tak bhi wife ke paas raaste hain. Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 "sexual abuse" ko domestic violence maanta hai, yaani koi bhi aisa sexual behaviour jo aurat ko abuse kare, humiliate kare, neecha dikhaye ya uski dignity ko chot pahunchaye [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]]. Yeh zyada tar civil law hai: magistrate protection, residence aur maintenance ke orders de sakta hai.

Shaadi saath zindagi bitane ka vaada hai. Yeh aane wali har raat par kiya gaya signature nahi hai.

Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

marriage-protects-from-hiv-myth.en:
Consider a 27-year-old in Nashik, married for three years and expecting her first child. At the antenatal clinic she is offered an HIV test along with her other blood tests. Her mother-in-law is puzzled: why would a married woman from a good family need that? The question rests on a belief many Indian families hold, that HIV belongs to sex workers, truck drivers and "other" people, and that a faithful wife has nothing to test for. The National AIDS Control Organisation's (NACO) data do not support it. Among 1,63,306 people newly diagnosed with HIV in 2024-25, 26.5% reported sex with a regular partner as their route of infection [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

## 'Not in families like ours'

The belief has a source. HIV programmes focus, rightly, on groups where the virus is far more common: in 2024, prevalence was 8.79% among people who inject drugs and 1.13% among female sex workers, against 0.20% among all adults [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Messaging about "high-risk groups" is easily heard as "other people's disease". But a risk group is a statistical label, not a wall. People in every one of those groups also have wives, husbands and steady partners.

Few people were ever told this plainly. In NFHS-5 (2019-21), only 22% of women and 31% of men aged 15 to 49 had comprehensive knowledge of HIV [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

The treatment registers show who actually lives with the virus. Of the 17.54 lakh people on antiretroviral therapy (ART) at government centres in March 2025, about 8.67 lakh were men and 7.98 lakh were women, along with 7,000 hijra or transgender people and around 80,000 children [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Women are nearly half.

## What index testing found

When someone is diagnosed with HIV, counsellors offer, with that person's consent, to test the people closest to the infection: spouses, sexual partners, needle-sharing partners and biological children. NACO calls this index testing.

In 2024-25, 12.1 lakh people living with HIV were offered the service and 10.8 lakh accepted. In all, 6.6 lakh contacts were tested, and 4.1% were positive [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

| Who was tested, 2024-25 | Tests | Positive |
|---|---|---|
| All at-risk clients | 4.13 crore | 0.40% |
| Spouses, partners and children of people with HIV | 6.6 lakh | 4.1% |

That is about ten times the positivity among at-risk people overall [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. No "risk group" label explains it. These people were exposed through sex with a partner, a shared needle or birth, not by sharing a home or a meal, which does not spread HIV [[who-hiv]].

Read the other side of the number too. Nearly 96 in every 100 contacts tested negative. Most partners of people with HIV did not have it, and learning that in time is what lets them stay negative.

> Marriage is a relationship, not a vaccine.

## How HIV enters a marriage

Of the people newly diagnosed in 2024-25, nearly 74% reported heterosexual sex as the route: 32.1% with casual partners, 26.5% with regular partners and 15.1% with commercial partners. Another 11.5% reported shared needles or syringes, 5.4% homosexual or bisexual sex, and 3.5% were infected from mother to child [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. These are self-reported answers, and stigma leads people to under-report sex between men and drug use.

The usual path into a marriage is simple. One partner acquires HIV, before the wedding or during the marriage, and does not know. In 2024-25, 83.9% of people living with HIV in India knew their status, so roughly one in six did not [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. A person with HIV can feel well for years [[who-hiv]], and a couple hoping for a child is not using condoms.

Then comes the unfairness. Pregnancy is when the health system most routinely offers a woman an HIV test; 84% of pregnant women were tested in 2024-25 [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. So a wife can easily be the first in a couple to get a result. Being tested first is not the same as being infected first, and a positive result is not proof of an affair. The infection may be older than the marriage. A family that blames the daughter-in-law is confusing the order of testing with the direction of the virus.

## Testing as care, not accusation

A test is the start of everything that protects a couple. A person on effective treatment whose viral load is undetectable does not pass HIV to sexual partners [[who-hiv]]. In India, 97.6% of people on treatment who were tested in 2024-25 had a suppressed viral load [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. A partner who is negative can stay negative with condoms and with PrEP, a preventive medicine prescribed by a doctor [[who-hiv]].

It protects a baby as well. India's estimated rate of mother-to-child transmission was 10.25% in 2024-25, down from more than 25% in 2020-21 [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Treatment for the mother is what brings it down [[who-hiv]], and it cannot begin without a diagnosis.

So change the sentence. "You should get tested" sounds like suspicion. "Let's both get tested" is what couples say when they plan a child, go for a routine health check-up or simply decide to know. The same holds for any long-term couple, whatever their gender.

The law protects the choice. Under the HIV and AIDS (Prevention and Control) Act, 2017, no one can be tested without informed consent or compelled to disclose their status except by a court order, and the Act bars discrimination against people with HIV and those who live with them [[naco-hiv-aids-act-2017-gazette]]. In-laws cannot force a test, and no one can make you reveal the result. If you fear violence over a result, tell the counsellor before you tell anyone at home.

## Confidential help: 1097 and testing

Government counselling and testing centres offer HIV tests [[naco]]. If you would rather ask first, call 1097, the national toll-free AIDS helpline. It gives confidential counselling round the clock in 16 languages, and received 4,32,474 calls in 2024-25 [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

If the result is positive, treatment is free at 800 government ART centres [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. If a possible exposure happened in the last 72 hours, ask a doctor urgently about PEP, a 28-day course that can prevent infection [[who-pep]].

The couples who are safest are not the ones who assume. They are the ones who have both seen a result.
marriage-protects-from-hiv-myth.hg:
Sochiye, Nashik ki ek 27 saal ki woman, jiski shaadi ko teen saal hue hain aur jo apne pehle bachche ki ummeed se hai. Antenatal clinic mein baaki blood tests ke saath use HIV test bhi offer hota hai. Uski saas hairaan hain: achhe ghar ki shaadi-shuda aurat ko is test ki kya zaroorat? Is sawaal ke peechhe ek soch hai jo bahut si Indian families mein hai: HIV sex workers, truck drivers aur 'doosre' logon ki bimari hai, aur faithful wife ko test ki koi zaroorat nahi. National AIDS Control Organisation (NACO) ka data is soch ka saath nahi deta. 2024-25 mein HIV ke naye diagnose hue 1,63,306 logon mein se 26.5% ne infection ka route regular partner ke saath sex bataya [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

## 'Hamare jaise gharon mein nahi hota'

Is soch ki ek wajah hai. HIV programmes un groups par focus karte hain jinmein virus kahin zyada common hai, aur yeh sahi bhi hai: 2024 mein injecting drugs lene wale logon mein prevalence 8.79% tha aur female sex workers mein 1.13%, jabki sabhi adults mein 0.20% [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. "High-risk groups" wali messaging aasaani se "doosre logon ki bimari" sunai deti hai. Lekin risk group ek statistical label hai, deewar nahi. In sabhi groups ke logon ke bhi wives, husbands aur steady partners hote hain.

Yeh baat logon ko saaf-saaf kabhi batayi hi nahi gayi. NFHS-5 (2019-21) mein 15 se 49 saal ki sirf 22% women aur 31% men ko HIV ki comprehensive knowledge thi [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Treatment registers dikhate hain ki virus ke saath asal mein kaun jee raha hai. March 2025 mein government centres par antiretroviral therapy (ART) le rahe 17.54 lakh logon mein kareeb 8.67 lakh men the aur 7.98 lakh women, saath hi 7,000 hijra ya transgender log aur kareeb 80,000 bachche [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Yaani lagbhag aadhi women hain.

## Index testing mein kya nikla

Jab kisi ko HIV diagnose hota hai, toh counsellors us insaan ki consent se un logon ka test offer karte hain jo infection ke sabse kareeb hain: spouses, sexual partners, needle share karne wale partners aur biological bachche. NACO ise index testing kehta hai.

2024-25 mein HIV ke saath jee rahe 12.1 lakh logon ko yeh service offer hui aur 10.8 lakh ne haan kaha. Kul 6.6 lakh contacts ka test hua, aur 4.1% positive nikle [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

| Kiska test hua, 2024-25 | Tests | Positive |
|---|---|---|
| Sabhi at-risk clients | 4.13 crore | 0.40% |
| HIV wale logon ke spouses, partners aur bachche | 6.6 lakh | 4.1% |

Yeh at-risk logon ki overall positivity ka kareeb das guna hai [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Ise samjhane ke liye kisi "risk group" label ki zaroorat nahi. In logon tak virus partner ke saath sex, shared needle ya janm ke zariye pahuncha, ek ghar mein rehne ya saath khana khane se nahi, kyunki usse HIV nahi phailta [[who-hiv]].

Is number ka doosra pehlu bhi padhiye. Har 100 contacts mein se kareeb 96 negative nikle. HIV wale logon ke zyadatar partners ko HIV nahi tha, aur yeh baat waqt par pata chalna hi unhe negative rehne mein madad karta hai.

> Shaadi ek rishta hai, vaccine nahi.

## HIV shaadi ke andar kaise aata hai

2024-25 mein naye diagnose hue logon mein se kareeb 74% ne route heterosexual sex bataya: 32.1% ne casual partners ke saath, 26.5% ne regular partners ke saath aur 15.1% ne commercial partners ke saath. Iske alawa 11.5% ne shared needles ya syringes bataya, 5.4% ne homosexual ya bisexual sex, aur 3.5% ko infection maa se bachche mein aaya [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Yeh logon ke khud bataye jawab hain, aur stigma ki wajah se men ke beech sex aur drug use kam report hote hain.

Shaadi ke andar aane ka aam raasta seedha hai. Ek partner ko HIV hota hai, shaadi se pehle ya shaadi ke dauraan, aur use pata nahi hota. 2024-25 mein India mein HIV ke saath jee rahe 83.9% logon ko apna status pata tha, yaani lagbhag har chhe mein se ek ko nahi [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. HIV wala insaan saalon tak theek mehsoos kar sakta hai [[who-hiv]], aur jo couple bachcha chahta hai woh condom use nahi kar raha hota.

Phir naainsaafi aati hai. Pregnancy woh waqt hai jab health system woman ko sabse routine tareeke se HIV test offer karta hai; 2024-25 mein 84% pregnant women ka HIV test hua [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Isliye couple mein result sabse pehle aasaani se wife ke haath mein aa sakta hai. Pehle test hona aur pehle infect hona ek baat nahi hai, aur positive result kisi affair ka saboot nahi hai. Infection shaadi se purana bhi ho sakta hai. Jo family bahu ko dosh deti hai, woh test ke order ko virus ki direction samajh rahi hai.

## Test ilzaam nahi, care hai

Couple ko protect karne wali har cheez test se shuru hoti hai. Jo insaan effective treatment par hai aur jiska viral load undetectable hai, woh sexual partners ko HIV pass nahi karta [[who-hiv]]. India mein 2024-25 mein treatment le rahe jin logon ka test hua, unmein se 97.6% ka viral load suppressed tha [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Jo partner negative hai, woh condoms aur PrEP ki madad se negative reh sakta hai; PrEP ek preventive medicine hai jo doctor prescribe karte hain [[who-hiv]].

Yeh bachche ko bhi protect karta hai. India mein maa se bachche mein HIV transmission ka estimated rate 2024-25 mein 10.25% tha, jo 2020-21 mein 25% se zyada tha [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Maa ka treatment hi ise neeche laata hai [[who-hiv]], aur treatment diagnosis ke bina shuru nahi ho sakta.

Isliye sentence badaliye. "Tum test karwao" shaq jaisa sunai deta hai. "Chalo, dono test karwate hain" woh baat hai jo couples tab kehte hain jab bachcha plan kar rahe hon, routine health check-up ke liye ja rahe hon, ya bas jaan lena chahte hon. Yahi baat har long-term couple par laagu hoti hai, chahe unka gender kuch bhi ho.

Law is choice ko protect karta hai. HIV and AIDS (Prevention and Control) Act, 2017 ke tahat informed consent ke bina kisi ka test nahi ho sakta, aur court order ke bina kisi ko apna status batane par majboor nahi kiya ja sakta. Yeh Act HIV wale logon aur unke saath rehne walon ke khilaf discrimination par bhi rok lagata hai [[naco-hiv-aids-act-2017-gazette]]. Sasuraal wale zabardasti test nahi karwa sakte, aur koi aapko result batane par majboor nahi kar sakta. Agar result ki wajah se violence ka darr ho, toh ghar mein kisi ko batane se pehle counsellor ko bataiye.

## Confidential help: 1097 aur testing

Government counselling aur testing centres par HIV test hota hai [[naco]]. Agar pehle poochhna chahein, toh 1097 par call kijiye, jo national toll-free AIDS helpline hai. Yeh din-raat 16 languages mein confidential counselling deti hai, aur 2024-25 mein is par 4,32,474 calls aayin [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

Agar result positive aaye, toh 800 government ART centres par treatment free hai [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Agar possible exposure pichhle 72 ghanton mein hua hai, toh turant doctor se PEP ke baare mein poochhiye; yeh 28 din ka course hai jo infection rok sakta hai [[who-pep]].

Sabse safe couples woh nahi hain jo maan kar chalte hain. Woh hain jin dono ne apna result dekha hai.

marriage-will-reform-him-myth.en:
The sentence is said with affection, usually by people who mean well. The boy drinks too much, so get him married; responsibility will settle him. He has a temper, so get him married; a wife will soften him. He shows no interest in girls, or the family has found out that he loves a man, so get him married quickly, before anyone talks. "Shaadi ke baad sudhar jayega." He will mend after the wedding.

Look at what the sentence does. It takes a problem the family could not solve in all his years at home and hands it to a young woman who was never told it existed.

## Marriage as a family's treatment plan

In this plan the bride is the medicine. Nobody asks whether she agreed to be one, and often nobody tells her what she is meant to treat. Her family is shown a salary, a house and a horoscope. The drinking, the smashed phone and the earlier "phase" are left out, because telling the truth would spoil the match.

The plan also fixes the blame in advance. If he keeps drinking, she did not manage him well. If he hits her, she must have provoked him. If the marriage is cold, she is not trying. A woman recruited as a cure becomes the explanation for every relapse.

And it lets everyone else off. Parents who arrange a wedding instead of a doctor's appointment have not dealt with their son's drinking or anger. They have moved it to another address.

## Drinking husbands and the 71% figure

The fifth National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5, 2019-21) shows where the moved problem lands. In it, 71% of women whose husbands often get drunk reported physical or sexual violence from them. Among women whose husbands do not drink, it was 23% [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Two cautions. This is an association, not proof that alcohol causes the violence; many men drink without ever raising a hand. And nearly a quarter of women whose husbands do not drink also reported violence, so sobriety alone does not guarantee safety. But nothing in these numbers supports the hope that a wedding ends heavy drinking or makes it harmless.

Drinking that a person cannot control is a health condition with a name. The National Mental Health Survey 2015-16 found alcohol use disorder in 9% of Indian men, against 0.5% of women. It also found a treatment gap of 86% for alcohol use disorders: the great majority of people who needed care were not getting it [[nimhans-nmhs-summary-2016]]. What is missing in most of these homes is a doctor, not a daughter-in-law.

## Violence starts early, not late

The myth imagines a rough first year and a settled man afterwards. The data runs the other way. Among currently married women who had married only once, 11.2% first faced physical or sexual violence from their husband within two years of the wedding, and 20.9% within five years [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. The survey report itself says a large proportion of spousal violence begins early in marriage.

Overall, 31.9% of ever-married women had faced physical, sexual or emotional violence from their husband, and 26.8% had faced it in the 12 months before the survey [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. For most of them, in other words, it was not a phase that had passed. And few get help. Among women who had experienced physical or sexual violence from anyone, husbands included, only 14.1% ever sought help; 77.2% never sought help or told anyone [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Imagine a 23-year-old in Nagpur, three months married. Her husband was drunk on the wedding night, and by Diwali he has thrown a plate at the wall. Her mother-in-law tells her that handling him is her job now; that is why she was brought into the family. Her own parents tell her to adjust. Nobody in either family has suggested that he see a doctor.

## Sexuality is not a condition to cure

The third use of the myth is different, because here nothing is wrong with the man at all. Being gay or bisexual is not an illness, and no wedding changes it. In June 2021 the Madras High Court, in a case brought by a lesbian couple, directed that any attempt to medically "cure" or change the sexual orientation or gender identity of LGBTQIA+ people be prohibited, with action against the professionals involved, including withdrawal of their licence [[livelaw-madras-hc-sushma-2021]]. In August 2022 the National Medical Commission told all state medical councils that conducting "conversion therapy" is professional misconduct [[scroll-nmc-conversion-therapy-2022]].

A forced wedding is the same attempt, made without a clinic. It injures two people. A son or daughter is pushed into a life built on hiding; queer women are married off this way too. And a spouse who was never told the truth says yes to a marriage that is not what it was described as. The fault lies with the family that arranged it, not with the person who was cornered and not with the bride.

No adult has to accept this. The Supreme Court held in 2018 that the right to choose a life partner is a facet of individual liberty [[barandbench-shakti-vahini-madras-pil-2021]]. This is general information, not legal advice.

## What to ask before the wedding

No checklist makes a match safe, but some questions are worth more than a horoscope. Ask him about drinking, directly and without the elders present: how often, how much, and what happens afterwards. Ask people outside his family. Notice how he handles a "no" or a disagreement during the engagement, because temper shown before the wedding is information. If you are told he "used to" drink, ask what treatment he has had. A promise to stop after marriage is not treatment.

Keep what makes leaving possible: your own bank account, phone, documents and a way to earn. Parents can do one thing that costs nothing. Say aloud, before the wedding, that your daughter can come home.

For the man himself, real help does not involve a bride. Treatment for drinking starts with a doctor, and Tele-MANAS, the Health Ministry's free round-the-clock mental health helpline, is on 14416 [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. A woman facing violence can call 112. Marriage can be many good things. It has never been a treatment.
marriage-will-reform-him-myth.hg:
Yeh line pyaar se kahi jaati hai, aur aksar woh log kehte hain jinki niyat achhi hoti hai. Ladka bahut peeta hai, toh shaadi kar do; zimmedari aayegi toh sambhal jayega. Use gussa bahut aata hai, toh shaadi kar do; biwi use naram kar degi. Ladkiyon mein uska interest nahi dikhta, ya ghar walon ko pata chal gaya hai ki woh ek mard se pyaar karta hai, toh jaldi shaadi kar do, isse pehle ki log baatein banayein. "Shaadi ke baad sudhar jayega."

Dekhiye yeh line karti kya hai. Jo problem family itne saalon mein ghar par hal nahi kar payi, use yeh ek jawaan aurat ke haath mein thama deti hai, jise kabhi bataya hi nahi gaya ki aisi koi problem hai.

## Shaadi: family ka treatment plan

Is plan mein dulhan dawa hai. Koi nahi poochta ki woh dawa banne ko raazi thi ya nahi, aur aksar koi use yeh bhi nahi batata ki use theek kya karna hai. Uski family ko salary, ghar aur kundli dikhayi jaati hai. Peena, toota hua phone aur pehle wala "phase" chhupa liye jaate hain, kyunki sach bataane se rishta bigad jaata.

Yeh plan ilzaam bhi pehle se tay kar deta hai. Agar woh peeta rahe, toh biwi ne use theek se sambhala nahi. Agar woh haath uthaye, toh biwi ne hi kuch kiya hoga. Agar shaadi mein thandapan hai, toh biwi koshish nahi kar rahi. Jis aurat ko ilaaj bana kar laaya gaya, wahi har relapse ki wajah bana di jaati hai.

Aur baaki sab chhoot jaate hain. Jo maa-baap doctor ke appointment ki jagah shaadi fix karte hain, unhone bete ke peene ya gusse ka kuch nahi kiya. Unhone bas problem ka address badal diya.

## Peene wale husbands aur 71% ka figure

National Family Health Survey ka paanchva round (NFHS-5, 2019-21) dikhata hai ki yeh shift ki hui problem kahan ja kar girti hai. Ismein jin aurton ke husband aksar nashe mein dhut hote hain, unmein se 71% ne husband ki physical ya sexual violence report ki. Jin aurton ke husband nahi peete, unmein yeh 23% tha [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Do baatein dhyaan mein rakhiye. Yeh ek association hai, is baat ka saboot nahi ki violence ki wajah alcohol hi hai; bahut se mard peete hain aur kabhi haath nahi uthate. Aur jin aurton ke husband nahi peete, unmein se bhi kareeb ek chauthai ne violence report ki, toh sirf peena chhod dena safety ki guarantee nahi hai. Par in numbers mein aisa kuch nahi hai jo is ummeed ko support kare ki shaadi heavy drinking khatam kar deti hai ya use bezarar bana deti hai.

Jo peena insaan ke control se bahar ho, woh ek health condition hai aur uska ek naam hai. National Mental Health Survey 2015-16 mein 9% Indian men ko alcohol use disorder paaya gaya, jabki women mein yeh 0.5% tha. Survey ne alcohol use disorders ke liye 86% ka treatment gap bhi paaya: jin logon ko care chahiye thi, unmein se zyada tar ko mil nahi rahi thi [[nimhans-nmhs-summary-2016]]. In mein se zyada tar gharon mein kami doctor ki hai, bahu ki nahi.

## Violence jaldi shuru hoti hai, der se nahi

Myth yeh sochta hai ki pehla saal thoda mushkil hoga aur uske baad aadmi settle ho jayega. Data ulta kehta hai. Jin currently married women ki ek hi baar shaadi hui thi, unmein se 11.2% ne shaadi ke do saal ke andar pehli baar husband ki physical ya sexual violence jheli, aur 20.9% ne paanch saal ke andar [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Survey report khud kehti hai ki spousal violence ka ek bada hissa shaadi ke shuru mein hi shuru ho jaata hai.

Kul mila kar 31.9% ever-married women ne husband ki physical, sexual ya emotional violence jheli thi, aur 26.8% ne survey se pehle ke 12 mahinon mein jheli thi [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Yaani inmein se zyada tar ke liye yeh koi beeta hua phase nahi tha. Aur madad bahut kam ko milti hai. Jin women ne kisi ki bhi, husband samet, physical ya sexual violence jheli thi, unmein se sirf 14.1% ne kabhi madad maangi; 77.2% ne na kabhi madad maangi, na kisi ko bataya [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Imagine kijiye Nagpur ki ek 23 saal ki ladki ko, jiski shaadi ko teen mahine hue hain. Shaadi ki raat uska husband nashe mein tha, aur Diwali tak woh ek plate deewar par de maar chuka hai. Saas kehti hai ki use sambhalna ab usi ka kaam hai; isi liye toh use is ghar mein laaya gaya hai. Uske apne maa-baap kehte hain ki adjust karo. Dono families mein kisi ne yeh nahi kaha ki ladke ko doctor ke paas le chalo.

## Sexuality koi bimaari nahi jise theek kiya jaaye

Myth ka teesra istemaal alag hai, kyunki yahan aadmi mein kuch galat hai hi nahi. Gay ya bisexual hona koi bimaari nahi hai, aur koi shaadi ise nahi badalti. June 2021 mein Madras High Court ne, ek lesbian couple ke case mein, direction di ki LGBTQIA+ logon ki sexual orientation ya gender identity ko medically "cure" karne ya badalne ki har koshish par rok lage, aur aisa karne wale professionals par action ho, jismein unka licence wapas lena bhi shaamil hai [[livelaw-madras-hc-sushma-2021]]. August 2022 mein National Medical Commission ne sabhi state medical councils ko bataya ki "conversion therapy" karna professional misconduct hai [[scroll-nmc-conversion-therapy-2022]].

Zabardasti ki shaadi wahi koshish hai, bas clinic ke bina. Yeh do logon ko chot pahunchati hai. Ek bete ya beti ko aisi zindagi mein dhakel diya jaata hai jo chhupane par tiki hai; queer women ki shaadi bhi isi tarah kar di jaati hai. Aur jis spouse ko sach kabhi bataya hi nahi gaya, woh ek aisi shaadi ke liye haan keh deta ya deti hai jo waisi hai hi nahi jaisi batayi gayi thi. Galti us family ki hai jisne yeh rishta karwaya, us insaan ki nahi jise corner kiya gaya, aur dulhan ki bhi nahi.

Kisi bhi adult ko yeh maanna zaroori nahi hai. Supreme Court ne 2018 mein kaha tha ki apna life partner chunne ka haq individual liberty ka hissa hai [[barandbench-shakti-vahini-madras-pil-2021]]. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## Shaadi se pehle kya poochein

Koi checklist rishte ko safe nahi bana sakti, par kuch sawaal kundli se zyada kaam ke hain. Usse peene ke baare mein seedhe poochiye, badon ki maujoodgi ke bina: kitni baar, kitna, aur uske baad kya hota hai. Uski family ke bahar ke logon se bhi poochiye. Engagement ke dauraan dekhiye ki woh "na" ya kisi asehmati ko kaise leta hai, kyunki shaadi se pehle dikha gussa bhi ek jaankari hai. Agar bataya jaaye ki woh "pehle" peeta tha, toh poochiye ki usne kya treatment liya. Shaadi ke baad chhod dene ka vaada treatment nahi hai.

Woh cheezein apne paas rakhiye jo nikalna mumkin banati hain: apna bank account, phone, documents aur kamaane ka zariya. Parents ek aisa kaam kar sakte hain jismein kuch kharch nahi hota. Shaadi se pehle, saaf shabdon mein keh dijiye ki beti ghar wapas aa sakti hai.

Khud us aadmi ke liye asli madad mein dulhan kahin nahi aati. Peene ka treatment doctor se shuru hota hai, aur Tele-MANAS, yaani Health Ministry ki free, round-the-clock mental health helpline, 14416 par hai [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. Violence jhel rahi aurat 112 par call kar sakti hai. Shaadi bahut si achhi cheezein ho sakti hai. Ilaaj woh kabhi nahi rahi.

masturbation-weakness-myth-schools-quack.en:
Imagine a 15-year-old in Kanpur. A "health tip" forwarded on a family WhatsApp group tells him that every time he masturbates he loses strength, that his eyes will weaken, and that he may not be able to father a child after marriage. He cannot ask his father. His teacher skipped the chapter. So he searches at night and finds an ad for "sex power" capsules that promise to restore what he has "lost". The details change from town to town. The claims don't, and none survives a look at the biology. What harms him is the fear, and the people who sell it.

## Weakness, blindness, infertility: the claims

The warnings come as a package. Masturbation, the forwards say, drains strength and "vital fluid". It ruins eyesight and memory. It causes pimples, hair fall and dark circles. It stunts growth. It leaves a man unable to father a child, or unable to perform on his wedding night.

Girls are mostly left out of the conversation, as if they had no sexual feelings to ask about. That silence carries its own message: the subject is shameful, and so is anyone curious about it.

The fear is old, handed down for generations as if it were medical wisdom. Medicine does not support it: losing semen does not drain strength. The fear has stayed on anyway, in hostels, families and phone screens.

## What medicine actually says

Masturbation is a normal, private activity for people of any gender. UNESCO's international guidance on sexuality education tells educators to teach young people exactly that: it does not cause physical or emotional harm, and it should be done in private [[unesco-itgse]]. The World Health Organization describes sexual health as well-being in relation to sexuality, built on a positive and respectful approach, not on fear [[who-sexual-health]].

Take the claims one by one.

- **Weakness.** Masturbation involves a small release of fluid and a short rise in heart rate. Then the body returns to normal. Semen loss does not drain strength, and feeling low afterwards is not a sign of damage. Guilt, worry and lost sleep can leave anyone tired.
- **Eyes, memory, skin, hair.** Medical science has found no evidence that masturbation damages any of them.
- **Infertility.** The testes make sperm continuously, so nothing gets "used up". Infertility has real medical causes, such as blocked tubes, hormone problems and untreated infections, which doctors can test for [[who-infertility]]. Masturbation is not one of them, in men or in women.
- **Pimples and height.** Acne and height are shaped by puberty hormones and genes. Masturbation does not change either.

Not masturbating is equally normal. The point is not that anyone should, but that nobody needs to be afraid.

## Why nobody corrects the myth: India's missing sex education

A myth survives where nobody contradicts it, and India has never made correcting this one anyone's clear job.

UNESCO's 2021 global review found that sexuality education in India is left to the states. It could name only one state-run programme working at scale: Jharkhand's Udaan, run in schools since 2006, which had reached over one million students by September 2019 [[unesco-cse-global-status-report-2021]]. The National Education Policy 2020 does not once use the words "sex", "sexual", "sexuality", "reproductive", "puberty" or "menstruation" in its 66 pages [[nep-2020-full-text]].

On paper, the School Health and Wellness Programme asks two trained teachers in every government and aided school to run one-hour weekly sessions on 11 health themes for 24 weeks a year [[pib-school-health-ambassador-curriculum-2020]]. An earlier national effort, the Adolescence Education Programme, hit a backlash in 2007. Reuters counted six states that had banned or refused it by that May [[reuters-nbc-india-states-ban-sex-ed-2007]]; a 2020 study in the journal Reproductive Health puts the number at 12 [[reprodhealth-plesons-jharkhand-cse-2020]]. Our timeline of India's sex-education fights tells that story.

In September 2024 the Supreme Court asked for more. It recommended comprehensive sex education and suggested the Union government set up an expert committee on health and sex education for children [[sc-just-rights-for-children-alliance-2024]]. These were suggestions, not binding orders.

So the questions go to whoever is available: older cousins, hostel seniors, pornography and the family-group forward. None of them corrects the myth. Some profit from it.

## The 'sex power' trade that profits from guilt

The business model is simple. First convince a young man that he has damaged himself. Then sell him the repair: capsules, oils, powders and "secret" consultations that promise to restore his "lost" strength.

Much of this advertising is already illegal. Section 3 of the Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act, 1954 bans advertising any drug for "the maintenance or improvement of the capacity of human beings for sexual pleasure" [[sc-ima-order-mar-2025]]. That clause describes exactly what a "sex power" ad promises.

The law has been left on paper. On 26 March 2025 the Supreme Court said that although the Act was more than 70 years old, "there is no implementation of the 1954 Act in its true letter and spirit". It ordered states to appoint enforcement officers and to set up ways for the public to complain, such as a toll-free number or email [[sc-ima-order-mar-2025]]. Our explainer on "dhat" and semen-loss anxiety looks at what these clinics do to the men who walk in.

## When to talk to a doctor or counsellor

Masturbation itself needs no treatment. It becomes a concern only when it causes injury or distress, or gets in the way of daily life: skipped classes, lost sleep, a habit that feels out of control. Constant guilt is worth talking through too; a counsellor can help with it.

- For worry, guilt or a habit that feels compulsive, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, the Health Ministry's free, round-the-clock mental-health helpline [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]].
- Teenagers can get counselling at Adolescent Friendly Health Centres in primary and community health centres, district hospitals and medical colleges [[nhm-afhc-page-2026]]. In October 2025 the Health Ministry renamed them from "clinics" to "centres", because adolescents hesitated to visit anything called a clinic [[mohfw-afhc-rename-2025]].
- For pain, a lump, blood in semen or burning while passing urine, see a qualified doctor, not a roadside "specialist".

The 15-year-old in Kanpur does not need a capsule. He needs one adult, or one honest page, to tell him that he was never broken.
masturbation-weakness-myth-schools-quack.hg:
Socho, Kanpur ka ek 15 saal ka ladka hai. Family WhatsApp group par forward hua ek "health tip" use batata hai ki har baar masturbate karne par uski taakat kam hoti hai, uski aankhein kamzor ho jayengi, aur shaadi ke baad shayad woh baap na ban paaye. Papa se woh pooch nahi sakta. Teacher ne woh chapter skip kar diya tha. Toh woh raat ko search karta hai aur use "sex power" capsules ka ek ad milta hai, jo uska "khoya hua" sab kuch lautane ka vaada karta hai. Sheher badalta hai toh details badal jaati hain. Daave wahi rehte hain, aur biology ke saamne ek bhi nahi tikta. Use nuksaan darr se hota hai, aur un logon se jo yeh darr bechte hain.

## Kamzori, andhapan, infertility: daave kya hain

Warnings ek poore package mein aati hain. Forwards kehte hain ki masturbation se taakat aur "vital fluid" nichud jaata hai. Aankhein aur yaaddaasht kharab hoti hain. Pimples, baal jhadna aur dark circles hote hain. Height ruk jaati hai. Aadmi baap nahi ban paata, ya shaadi ki raat "perform" nahi kar paata.

Ladkiyon ko is baatcheet se zyada tar bahar hi rakha jaata hai, jaise unke paas poochne layak koi sexual feelings hon hi na. Us chuppi ka apna ek message hai: yeh topic sharmnaak hai, aur jo bhi iske baare mein curious hai, woh bhi.

Yeh darr purana hai, jo peedhiyon se aise aage badhaya gaya jaise yeh medical gyaan ho. Medicine iska saath nahi deti: semen nikalne se taakat nahi nichudti. Phir bhi darr hostels, families aur phone screens par tika hua hai.

## Medicine asal mein kya kehti hai

Masturbation ek normal, private activity hai, chahe gender koi bhi ho. UNESCO ki sexuality education par international guidance educators se kehti hai ki young logon ko theek yahi sikhaya jaaye: isse na physical nuksaan hota hai na emotional, aur ise private mein kiya jaana chahiye [[unesco-itgse]]. World Health Organization sexual health ko sexuality se judi well-being batata hai, jo positive aur respectful approach par bani ho, darr par nahi [[who-sexual-health]].

Ab ek-ek daava dekho.

- **Kamzori.** Masturbation mein thoda sa fluid nikalta hai aur kuch der ke liye heart rate badhta hai. Phir body normal ho jaati hai. Semen nikalne se taakat nahi nichudti, aur baad mein low feel karna kisi nuksaan ka sign nahi hai. Guilt, chinta aur kam neend kisi ko bhi thaka sakte hain.
- **Aankhein, yaaddaasht, skin, baal.** Medical science ko aisa koi evidence nahi mila ki masturbation inmein se kisi ko bhi nuksaan pahunchata hai.
- **Infertility.** Testes lagataar sperm banate rehte hain, toh kuch bhi "khatam" nahi hota. Infertility ki asli medical wajahein hoti hain, jaise blocked tubes, hormone ki problems aur bina ilaaj ke chhode gaye infections, jinka doctor test kar sakte hain [[who-infertility]]. Masturbation unmein se ek nahi hai, na mardon mein, na aurton mein.
- **Pimples aur height.** Acne aur height puberty ke hormones aur genes se tay hote hain. Masturbation in dono mein se kisi ko nahi badalta.

Masturbate na karna bhi utna hi normal hai. Baat yeh nahi hai ki kisi ko karna chahiye; baat yeh hai ki kisi ko darne ki zaroorat nahi.

## Myth ko koi theek kyun nahi karta: India ki gayab sex education

Myth wahin zinda rehti hai jahan use koi kaatta nahi, aur India ne is myth ko theek karna kabhi kisi ki saaf zimmedaari banaya hi nahi.

UNESCO ke 2021 ke global review ne paaya ki India mein sexuality education states par chhodi gayi hai. Bade scale par chalne wala state-run programme use sirf ek mila: Jharkhand ka Udaan, jo 2006 se schools mein chal raha hai aur September 2019 tak over one million, yaani das lakh se zyada, students tak pahunch chuka tha [[unesco-cse-global-status-report-2021]]. National Education Policy 2020 apne 66 pages mein ek baar bhi "sex", "sexual", "sexuality", "reproductive", "puberty" ya "menstruation" shabd use nahi karti [[nep-2020-full-text]].

Kaagaz par, School Health and Wellness Programme har government aur aided school mein do trained teachers se kehta hai ki woh saal ke 24 hafte, har hafte ek ghante ke sessions mein 11 health themes cover karein [[pib-school-health-ambassador-curriculum-2020]]. Isse pehle ki ek national koshish, Adolescence Education Programme, 2007 mein backlash se takra gayi. Reuters ne us saal May tak chhe states gine jinhone ise ban kar diya tha ya chalane se mana kar diya tha [[reuters-nbc-india-states-ban-sex-ed-2007]]; Reproductive Health journal ki 2020 ki ek study yeh ginti 12 batati hai [[reprodhealth-plesons-jharkhand-cse-2020]]. Woh poori kahani India ki sex-education ladaiyon par hamari timeline mein hai.

September 2024 mein Supreme Court ne isse zyada maanga. Usne comprehensive sex education ki recommendation ki aur suggest kiya ki Union government bachchon ke liye health aur sex education par ek expert committee banaye [[sc-just-rights-for-children-alliance-2024]]. Yeh suggestions the, binding orders nahi.

Toh sawaal unke paas jaate hain jo available hain: bade cousins, hostel seniors, pornography aur family-group ka forward. Inmein se koi myth ko theek nahi karta. Kuch toh usse kamaate hain.

## 'Sex power' ka dhandha jo guilt se kamaata hai

Business model seedha hai. Pehle ek jawaan ladke ko yakeen dilao ki usne khud ko nuksaan pahuncha liya hai. Phir use repair becho: capsules, tel, powder aur "secret" consultations, jo uski "khoyi hui" taakat lautane ka vaada karte hain.

Is advertising ka bada hissa pehle se gair-kanooni hai. Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act, 1954 ka Section 3 kisi bhi aisi drug ke ad par ban lagata hai jo "the maintenance or improvement of the capacity of human beings for sexual pleasure" ke liye ho, yaani insaan ki sexual pleasure ki capacity banaye rakhne ya badhane ke liye [[sc-ima-order-mar-2025]]. "Sex power" ka ad theek yahi vaada karta hai.

Kanoon kaagaz par hi pada raha. 26 March 2025 ko Supreme Court ne kaha ki Act 70 saal se zyada purana hone ke bawajood "there is no implementation of the 1954 Act in its true letter and spirit", yaani yeh apne asli roop mein laagu hi nahi hua. Court ne states ko enforcement officers appoint karne aur public ke liye complaint ke raaste banane ka order diya, jaise toll-free number ya email [[sc-ima-order-mar-2025]]. "Dhat" aur semen-loss anxiety par hamara explainer batata hai ki yeh clinics andar aane wale mardon ke saath kya karte hain.

## Doctor ya counsellor se kab baat karein

Masturbation ko khud kisi ilaaj ki zaroorat nahi. Yeh chinta ki baat tabhi banta hai jab isse chot lage, distress ho, ya roz ki zindagi mein rukaawat aaye: classes chhootna, neend kharab hona, aisi aadat jo control se bahar lage. Lagataar rehne wala guilt bhi baat karne layak hai; counsellor ismein madad kar sakta hai.

- Chinta, guilt ya compulsive lagne wali aadat ke liye Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call karo. Yeh Health Ministry ki free, chaubees ghante chalne wali mental-health helpline hai [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]].
- Teenagers ko primary aur community health centres, district hospitals aur medical colleges ke Adolescent Friendly Health Centres mein counselling mil sakti hai [[nhm-afhc-page-2026]]. October 2025 mein Health Ministry ne inka naam "clinics" se badalkar "centres" kiya, kyunki adolescents "clinic" naam ki jagah par jaane se hichkichate the [[mohfw-afhc-rename-2025]].
- Dard, gaanth, semen mein khoon ya peshaab karte waqt jalan ho, toh qualified doctor ko dikhao, sadak kinare ke "specialist" ko nahi.

Kanpur ke us 15 saal ke ladke ko capsule ki zaroorat nahi hai. Use ek adult, ya ek imaandaar page, chahiye jo use bataye ki woh kabhi toota hi nahi tha.

men-cannot-be-raped-gender-neutral-bns.en:
Say it in a hostel corridor or an office canteen and someone will laugh: men can't be raped. A man, the myth goes, is either strong enough to stop it or secretly glad it happened. Since 1 July 2024, India's main criminal law has stopped arguing. The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) defines rape as an act by "a man" against "a woman" [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. It also dropped Section 377 of the old Indian Penal Code, which had punished non-consensual "carnal intercourse against the order of nature" with any man, woman or animal with up to life imprisonment, and put nothing in its place [[scroll-delhi-hc-unnatural-offences-bns-2024]].

## The myth: a real man can't be assaulted

The myth rests on two ideas: that strength decides everything, so an assaulted man must not have resisted, and that men always want sex, so a man cannot really be unwilling. Both are wrong. For women, the law already rejects the first: under Section 63, a woman who does not physically resist is not, for that reason alone, consenting [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Fear, threats or a person with power over you can stop anyone from resisting. And a body's reaction is not agreement. Consent is a decision, not a reflex.

The myth starts young. UNICEF estimates that about 1 in 11 boys and men alive today were raped or sexually assaulted in childhood [[unicef-sexual-violence-children-2024]]. In India, police recorded 892 boys among child victims of penetrative sexual assault under POCSO in 2024, a number that reflects how rarely boys are reported, not how rarely they are abused [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Those boys grow into men who have been told it cannot happen to them.

## What 'gender-neutral' meant in the Home Ministry's note

In July 2024, the Home Ministry's note on the new laws said "various offences against women and children have been made gender-neutral in BNS, covering all victims and perpetrators regardless of gender", and that the definition of gender "now includes transgender individuals" [[pib-new-criminal-laws-2024]].

Read the code itself and the claim shrinks. The BNS does say the pronoun "he" covers any person, "whether male, female or transgender". But it defines a "man" as male and a "woman" as female, which keeps rape limited to a man assaulting a woman [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Whatever was made gender-neutral, rape was not.

## 'A man' and 'a woman': Section 63 in plain words

Section 63 begins: "A man is said to commit 'rape' if he…", and every act it lists is done to a woman. Only a man can commit rape and only a woman can be raped; an adult man cannot legally be a rape victim [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. The myth says it cannot happen to a man. The law now says, in effect, that if it does, it is not rape.

When the Supreme Court decriminalised consensual sex between adults of the same sex in Navtej Singh Johar (2018), it kept Section 377 for non-consensual acts [[scobserver-navtej-johar-2018]]. That was the offence a man assaulted by another man could turn to.
