Cases often end in "adjust" too. In 2024, 16,396 cases of cruelty by a husband or his relatives ended in compromise or compounding, more than the 10,689 that ended in conviction [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Some compromises are genuine reconciliations; the data cannot say how many were pressure.

Fear itself is information. In NFHS-5, 59% of women who were afraid of their husband most of the time had experienced violence from him, against 15% of women who were never afraid of him [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

## A world that is counting less

The number of countries reporting data on women killed by partners or family peaked at 75 in 2020 and had fallen by half by 2023. UNODC and UN Women warned that attention may have waned after the COVID-19 pandemic [[unodc-unwomen-femicides-2023]]. India's records scatter such deaths across columns: in 2024 police recorded only 36 murders with "honour killing" as the motive, against 1,391 attributed to "love affairs" [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

What is not counted is easy to call rare. What is called rare is easy to blame on strangers.

## Warning signs and a safety plan

Treat these as emergencies, not family matters: threats to kill her or her children; violence that is getting more frequent or more severe; dowry demands backed by threats; relatives threatening a daughter or sister over a partner she chose; and her own words when she says she fears for her life.

A safety plan does not have to be perfect to help. It can start with:

- **one person outside the house** who knows what is happening, and a code word that means "get help now";
- **a charged phone** with the emergency number 112 and the Women Helpline saved;
- **copies of documents**, such as ID, bank papers, marriage certificate, medical records and any complaint, plus some cash, kept with someone trusted;
- **the nearest One Stop Centre (Sakhi)**: as of July 2026, 985 were operational across India, and they had assisted over 15.20 lakh women since April 2015 [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-07]];
- **a court order**: under the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005, a magistrate can pass protection, residence and maintenance orders, and breaking a protection order is a crime, though it carries at most one year in prison, a Rs 20,000 fine, or both [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]].

This is general information, not legal advice. If someone is in danger right now, call 112.
women-killed-by-family-not-strangers.hg:
Kisi aurat ke qatl ki tasveer waise sochiye jaise crime shows sikhaate hain: ek ajnabi, sunsaan sadak, der raat. Ab aankde dekhiye. 2024 mein duniya ke homicide victims mein 80% mard aur ladke the, aur male victims mein sirf 11% ko partner ya rishtedaar ne maara. Aurton aur ladkiyon ke liye pattern ulat jaata hai: jinka qatl hua unmein se lagbhag 60% partner ya family member ke haathon maari gayin [[unodc-unwomen-femicides-2024]]. Aurat ko maarne wala aam taur par andheri sadak par intezaar karta ajnabi nahi hota. Aadhe se zyada maamlon mein woh koi hota hai jise woh apna parivar kehti hai.

## Woh qaatil jiski hum tasveer banaate hain

Parivar qatl ke darr ka jawab waise hi dete hain jaise rape ke darr ka: curfew, saath mein koi, bhai ko saath bhejna, "pahunch kar call karna". Yeh sab sadak ki nigraani hai. Ajnabiyon ke haathon qatl sach mein hote hain, lekin qatl hui zyada tar aurtein aur ladkiyan partners ya rishtedaaron ke haathon maari jaati hain, aur ajnabi wali tasveer dhyaan ghar se hata deti hai.

Ek hypothetical sochiye. Kanpur ki ek 24 saal ki aurat, jiski shaadi ko teen saal hue hain, apne maa-baap ko do baar batati hai ki uske sasuraal wale baar-baar paise maangte hain aur use darr lagta hai. Maa-baap kehte hain adjust karo; har shaadi mein problems hoti hain. Uske aas-paas sab is baat se pareshaan hain ki woh raat ko akele aati-jaati hai. Koi bhi apne hi ghar se uske darr ko emergency nahi maanta.

## Aurton ko asal mein kaun maarta hai

2024 mein duniya bhar mein lagbhag 50,000 aurton aur ladkiyon ko intimate partner ya kisi doosre family member ne maara: yeh us saal jaan-boojhkar maari gayi lagbhag 83,000 aurton aur ladkiyon ka 60% hai, yaani har din 137 [[unodc-unwomen-femicides-2024]]. Inmein se anumaanit 17,400 qatl Asia mein hue, jo Africa ke 22,600 ke baad doosre number par hai, aur Asia mein maari gayi aurton mein 55% partner ya rishtedaar ke haathon maari gayin [[unodc-unwomen-femicides-2024]].

Yahan "family" ka matlab sirf pati nahi hai. Europe aur Americas ke bahar, jin deshon ka data hai unmein, 2023 mein private sphere mein maari gayi aurtein partners (41%) se zyada doosre family members (59%) ke haathon maari gayin [[unodc-unwomen-femicides-2023]]. Kisi Indian ghar mein iska matlab ho sakta hai shaadi ki pasand par naaraz baap ya bhai, ya dahej ke liye sasuraal wale.

India partners ya rishtedaaron ke haathon maari gayi aurton ki koi ek ginti publish nahi karta; India ke gaayab femicide count par hamari investigation is gap ko detail mein dekhti hai. Ek category se andaaza lagta hai. UNODC ne paaya ki 1999 se 2016 tak har saal India mein darj sabhi female homicides mein 40% se 50% akele dowry deaths thin [[unodc-gsh-gender-killing-2018]]. 2024 mein police ne dowry death ke 5,737 cases darj kiye, yaani har din lagbhag 16 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita ki Section 80 ke tahat dowry death woh hai jab kisi aurat ki shaadi ke saat saal ke andar asaamaanya haalat mein maut ho, aur maut se kuch hi pehle pati ya uske rishtedaaron ne dahej ko lekar uske saath cruelty ki ho [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Inmein se koi bhi ajnabi ka crime nahi hai.

## Woh qatl jinki khabar pehle hi di gayi thi

Myth ka doosra hissa yeh hai ki aise qatl achanak hote hain: "woh ek pal mein bhadak gaya", "crime of passion" tha. Aksar chetaavniyan pehle se thin. France (2019-2022), South Africa (2020-2021) aur Colombia (2014-2017) mein partner ke haathon maari gayi aurton mein 22% se 37% ne pehle hi us partner ki physical, sexual ya psychological hinsa ki report ki thi. UNODC aur UN Women ise is baat ka sanket maante hain ki aise kai qatl roke ja sakte hain [[unodc-unwomen-femicides-2023]]. India ke liye humein aisa koi data nahi mila.

India mein chetaavniyan shayad hi kisi aise insaan tak pahunchti hain jiske paas kuch karne ki taaqat ho. NFHS-5 (2019-21) mein physical ya sexual hinsa jhel chuki 18-49 saal ki aurton mein sirf 14.1% ne kabhi madad maangi, aur 77.2% ne na madad maangi, na kisi ko bataya. Jinhone madad maangi, unmein 60.9% apne parivar ke paas gayin aur 6.3% police ke paas [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Parivar hi pehla madadgaar hai, aur kabhi-kabhi parivar hi khatra hai.

Cases bhi aksar "adjust" par hi khatam hote hain. 2024 mein pati ya uske rishtedaaron ki cruelty ke 16,396 cases compromise ya compounding par khatam hue, jo conviction par khatam hue 10,689 cases se zyada hain [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Kuch compromise sachche samjhaute hote hain; data yeh nahi bata sakta ki kitne dabaav mein hue.

Darr khud ek jaankari hai. NFHS-5 mein jo aurtein zyada tar waqt apne pati se darti thin, unmein 59% ne uski hinsa jheli thi, jabki jo kabhi nahi darti thin unmein yeh hissa 15% tha [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

## Ek duniya jo kam gin rahi hai

Partners ya family ke haathon maari gayi aurton ka data report karne wale deshon ki sankhya 2020 mein 75 par sabse upar thi, aur 2023 tak aadhi reh gayi. UNODC aur UN Women ne chetaaya ki COVID-19 pandemic ke baad is par dhyaan kam ho gaya hoga [[unodc-unwomen-femicides-2023]]. India ke records aisi maut ko alag-alag columns mein bikher dete hain: 2024 mein police ne sirf 36 qatl "honour killing" motive ke saath darj kiye, jabki 1,391 "love affairs" ke naam par [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Jo gina nahi jaata, use durlabh kehna aasaan hai. Aur jise durlabh kaha jaata hai, use ajnabiyon par daalna aasaan hai.

## Khatre ke sanket aur safety plan

Inhe family ka maamla nahi, emergency samjhiye: use ya uske bachchon ko jaan se maarne ki dhamki; hinsa jo zyada baar ya zyada gambhir ho rahi hai; dhamkiyon ke saath dahej ki maang; rishtedaar jo kisi beti ya behen ko uske chune hue partner ki wajah se dhamka rahe hain; aur uske apne shabd, jab woh kahe ki use apni jaan ka darr hai.

Safety plan ka perfect hona zaroori nahi. Shuruaat aise ho sakti hai:

- **ghar ke bahar ek insaan** jise sab pata ho, aur ek code word jiska matlab ho "abhi madad bulao";
- **charged phone** jismein emergency number 112 aur Women Helpline save hon;
- **documents ki copies**, jaise ID, bank papers, shaadi ka certificate, medical records aur koi bhi complaint, aur kuch cash, kisi bharosemand insaan ke paas;
- **sabse paas ka One Stop Centre (Sakhi)**: July 2026 tak India mein 985 chal rahe the, aur April 2015 se ab tak 15.20 lakh se zyada aurton ki madad kar chuke the [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-07]];
- **court ka order**: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 ke tahat magistrate protection, residence aur maintenance orders de sakta hai, aur protection order todna crime hai, haalaanki iski saza zyada se zyada ek saal ki jail, Rs 20,000 jurmana, ya dono hai [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]].

Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi. Agar koi abhi khatre mein hai, toh 112 par call kariye.

workplace-harassment-just-a-joke-myth.en:
Consider this situation. A 24-year-old joins a sales team in Gurugram. Within a month the team's WhatsApp group fills with 'non-veg' jokes, a senior praises her figure in a meeting, and one night someone forwards a porn clip "for fun". When she stops replying, she is told she has no sense of humour. Each of those acts, if unwelcome, fits the definition of sexual harassment the Supreme Court laid down on 13 August 1997 [[sc-vishaka-1997]].

## 'Just banter': how harassment hides

The joke is harassment's oldest cover. It moves the question from what was done to how she took it. If she objects, she is "too sensitive". If she laughs, she "was fine with it". Nobody looks at the conduct.

Words soften it too. In 2023 the Supreme Court told judges to replace "eve teasing" with "street sexual harassment" [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]]. In offices, "masti" and "banter" do the same softening.

Laughing along is not agreement. A junior who laughs at her manager's remark may be protecting her appraisal or her job. In the 2021 #MeToo defamation verdict, a Delhi court observed that most women who suffer such abuse do not speak up, often for years, because of shame and social stigma [[delhi-court-metoo-defamation-judgment-2021]].

## What Vishaka and the BNS actually cover

In Vishaka v. State of Rajasthan, the Supreme Court defined sexual harassment as unwelcome sexually determined behaviour, "whether directly or by implication": physical contact and advances, a demand or request for sexual favours, sexually coloured remarks, showing pornography, and any other unwelcome physical, verbal or non-verbal conduct of a sexual nature [[sc-vishaka-1997]]. The POSH Act of 2013 turned those guidelines into law [[pib-law-posh-act-gazette-2013]]; our case file on the 1992 Rajasthan case behind Vishaka tells that story.

Two of the five forms are words and images. Nothing in the list asks whether the sender meant it as a joke. It asks whether the conduct was sexual and whether it was welcome.

Criminal law covers the same ground. Section 75 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) punishes sexual harassment with up to three years in prison, and sexually coloured remarks with up to one year; Section 79 punishes words or gestures meant to insult a woman's modesty with up to three years [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Police registered 15,609 sexual harassment cases in 2024, down from 17,544 in 2023 and 17,809 in 2022, plus 9,338 cases of insulting a woman's modesty [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Both routes are written for women. The POSH Act protects women [[gazette-posh-act-2013]], and Section 75, by its wording, can only be committed by a man [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. A transgender employee can turn to the Transgender Persons Act, under which sexual abuse carries six months to two years [[gazette-transgender-amendment-act-2026]]. Otherwise, men and transgender employees must look to the employer's own policy, if it covers them.

## The women who quietly leave

Police figures are a poor mirror of workplace harassment. Of those 15,609 cases, only 388 were recorded at office premises, and 512 at other work premises such as shops, factories and homes in the second half of 2024, when that category began [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Most workplace complaints go to an employer's Internal Committee, a civil process, and never become an FIR. Many never become a complaint at all.

In 2023 the Supreme Court described what happens instead. Harassed women are often reluctant to report, and "many of them even drop out from their job", partly because they do not know whom to approach and lack confidence in the process [[sc-aureliano-fernandes-2023]]. Women not assured a safe workplace, the bench warned, "will fear stepping out of their homes to make a dignified living" [[sc-aureliano-fernandes-2023]].

The International Labour Office estimated in 2017 that abuse, harassment or discrimination at work lowers a woman's probability of taking part in the labour market by 2.0 percentage points in middle-income countries, the group that includes India, and by 4.2 points in low-income countries [[ilo-weso-trends-women-2017]]. These are cross-country estimates, not Indian measurements, but the lesson holds: the 'joke' nobody stops can end a career.

## Where the line is

The law does not ban attraction, asking a colleague out once, or humour that is not sexual. It bans sexual conduct that is unwelcome. Ask three questions. Is it sexual? Did the person invite it, or did they go quiet, change the subject or start avoiding you? Does the 'joker' write her appraisal or set her shifts?

| What gets called a joke | What the 1997 definition calls it, if unwelcome |
|---|---|
| A 'non-veg' joke about a colleague in the team chat | Sexually coloured remark |
| "Wear that dress more often, it shows off your figure" | Sexually coloured remark |
| A porn clip forwarded to the team group "for fun" | Showing pornography |
| "Spend the weekend with me and your confirmation is sorted" | Demand or request for sexual favours |
| A hand on her back that keeps coming back | Physical contact and advances |

## Holding the line as a colleague

A joke needs an audience, and colleagues can take the audience away. Don't laugh, react or forward. Say it once, plainly: "Not funny. Delete it." Then check privately with the person it targeted, and let her decide what happens next.

If she complains, your account as a witness can carry it. A written complaint is due within three months of the last incident, extendable by up to three more if something stopped her filing in time, and the inquiry must finish within 90 days [[gazette-posh-act-2013]]. Money cannot be the basis of a settlement, and failing to prove a complaint does not, by itself, expose her to action [[gazette-posh-act-2013]]. Our guide for managers and committee members covers the rest.

The criminal route stays open, and a woman police officer must record the complaint [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Courts convicted in 41.9% of sexual harassment trials completed in 2024, but 93.3% of cases, 1,22,888 in all, were still pending at year-end [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

A joke that works only while one person in the room stays uncomfortable is not a joke. Since 1997 it has had a legal name.

This is general information, not legal advice.
workplace-harassment-just-a-joke-myth.hg:
Yeh situation socho. Ek 24 saal ki ladki Gurugram mein ek sales team join karti hai. Ek mahine ke andar team ka WhatsApp group 'non-veg' jokes se bhar jaata hai, ek senior meeting mein uske figure ki taareef karta hai, aur ek raat koi "for fun" ek porn clip forward kar deta hai. Jab woh reply karna band kar deti hai, toh use kaha jaata hai ki usmein sense of humour nahi hai. Inmein se har act, agar unwelcome hai, toh sexual harassment ki us definition mein fit hota hai jo Supreme Court ne 13 August 1997 ko di thi [[sc-vishaka-1997]].

## 'Bas banter hai': harassment kaise chhupta hai

Joke harassment ka sabse purana parda hai. Yeh sawaal ko "kya kiya gaya" se hata kar "usne kaise liya" par le aata hai. Woh objection kare toh "too sensitive" hai. Hans de toh "use toh koi problem nahi thi". Conduct ko koi nahi dekhta.

Shabd bhi ise halka kar dete hain. 2023 mein Supreme Court ne judges se kaha ki "eve teasing" ki jagah "street sexual harassment" likhein [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]]. Offices mein yahi kaam "masti" aur "banter" jaise shabd karte hain.

Saath mein hans dena agreement nahi hai. Jo junior apne manager ke remark par hansti hai, woh shayad apna appraisal ya apni job bacha rahi hoti hai. 2021 ke #MeToo defamation verdict mein Delhi ki ek court ne observe kiya ki aisa abuse jhelne wali zyada tar aurtein sharam aur social stigma ki wajah se bolti nahi, aksar saalon tak [[delhi-court-metoo-defamation-judgment-2021]].

## Vishaka aur BNS asal mein kya cover karte hain

Vishaka v. State of Rajasthan mein Supreme Court ne sexual harassment ko unwelcome sexually determined behaviour ke roop mein define kiya, "whether directly or by implication", yaani seedhe ho ya ishaare mein: physical contact aur advances, sexual favours ki demand ya request, sexually coloured remarks, pornography dikhana, aur sexual nature ka koi bhi aur unwelcome physical, verbal ya non-verbal conduct [[sc-vishaka-1997]]. 2013 ke POSH Act ne un guidelines ko kanoon bana diya [[pib-law-posh-act-gazette-2013]]; Vishaka ke peeche ke 1992 ke Rajasthan case par hamari case file woh kahani batati hai.

Paanch mein se do forms shabd aur images hain. List mein kahin nahi poocha gaya ki bhejne wale ne ise mazaak samjha tha ya nahi. Poocha yeh gaya hai ki conduct sexual tha ya nahi, aur welcome tha ya nahi.

Criminal law bhi yahi zameen cover karta hai. Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ka Section 75 sexual harassment par teen saal tak ki jail deta hai, aur sexually coloured remarks par ek saal tak; Section 79 aurat ki modesty ka apmaan karne ke iraade se kahe gaye shabdon ya gestures par teen saal tak ki saza deta hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Police ne 2024 mein sexual harassment ke 15,609 cases register kiye, jo 2023 ke 17,544 aur 2022 ke 17,809 se kam hain, aur saath mein aurat ki modesty ke apmaan ke 9,338 cases [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Dono raaste aurton ke liye likhe gaye hain. POSH Act aurton ko protect karta hai [[gazette-posh-act-2013]], aur Section 75 ka offence, uske shabdon ke hisaab se, sirf mard hi kar sakta hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Transgender employee Transgender Persons Act ka sahaara le sakta hai, jismein sexual abuse par chhe mahine se do saal tak ki saza hai [[gazette-transgender-amendment-act-2026]]. Warna mard aur transgender employees ko employer ki apni policy dekhni padti hai, agar woh unhe cover karti ho.

## Woh aurtein jo chupchaap chali jaati hain

Police ke figures workplace harassment ka kamzor aaina hain. Un 15,609 cases mein se sirf 388 office premises par record hue, aur 512 doosre work premises par, jaise shops, factories aur ghar, 2024 ke doosre half mein, jab yeh category shuru hui [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Zyada tar workplace complaints employer ki Internal Committee ke paas jaati hain, jo ek civil process hai, aur kabhi FIR nahi banti. Kai toh complaint bhi nahi banti.

2023 mein Supreme Court ne bataya ki iski jagah kya hota hai. Harass hui aurtein aksar report karne se hichkichati hain, aur "many of them even drop out from their job", yaani unmein se kai job hi chhod deti hain, kuch isliye ki unhe pata nahi hota kiske paas jaayein aur process par bharosa nahi hota [[sc-aureliano-fernandes-2023]]. Bench ne warn kiya ki jin aurton ko safe workplace ka bharosa nahi milta, woh "will fear stepping out of their homes to make a dignified living", yaani izzat ki rozi kamaane ke liye ghar se nikalne se darengi [[sc-aureliano-fernandes-2023]].

International Labour Office ne 2017 mein estimate kiya ki kaam par abuse, harassment ya discrimination middle-income countries mein, jis group mein India aata hai, aurat ke labour market mein hissa lene ki probability 2.0 percentage points kam kar deta hai, aur low-income countries mein 4.2 points [[ilo-weso-trends-women-2017]]. Yeh cross-country estimates hain, India ke apne measurements nahi, lekin sabak wahi hai: jis 'joke' ko koi nahi rokta, woh ek career khatam kar sakta hai.

## Line kahan hai

Kanoon attraction par, colleague ko ek baar date ke liye poochne par, ya us humour par ban nahi lagata jo sexual nahi hai. Ban us sexual conduct par hai jo unwelcome hai. Teen sawaal poocho. Kya yeh sexual hai? Kya saamne wale ne ise invite kiya tha, ya woh chup ho gaya, topic badal diya ya tumse bachne laga? Kya 'joker' hi uska appraisal likhta hai ya uski shifts tay karta hai?

| Jise joke kaha jaata hai | 1997 ki definition use kya kehti hai, agar unwelcome ho |
|---|---|
| Team chat mein kisi colleague par 'non-veg' joke | Sexually coloured remark |
| "Yeh dress zyada pehna karo, figure achha dikhta hai" | Sexually coloured remark |
| Team group mein "for fun" forward ki gayi porn clip | Pornography dikhana |
| "Weekend mere saath bitao, tumhara confirmation pakka" | Sexual favours ki demand ya request |
| Uski peeth par baar-baar lautne wala haath | Physical contact aur advances |

## Colleague ke taur par line kaise pakdein

Joke ko audience chahiye, aur colleagues woh audience hata sakte hain. Hanso mat, react mat karo, forward mat karo. Ek baar, saaf shabdon mein bolo: "Not funny. Delete karo." Phir jise target kiya gaya usse akele mein baat karo, aur aage kya hoga yeh use tay karne do.

Agar woh complaint karti hai, toh witness ke taur par tumhara bayaan use mazboot kar sakta hai. Written complaint last incident ke teen mahine ke andar deni hoti hai, jo teen mahine aur badh sakti hai agar kisi wajah se woh time par file nahi kar paayi, aur inquiry 90 din ke andar poori honi chahiye [[gazette-posh-act-2013]]. Paisa settlement ka basis nahi ban sakta, aur complaint saabit na kar paana apne aap mein uske khilaaf action ki wajah nahi banta [[gazette-posh-act-2013]]. Baaki sab managers aur committee members ke liye hamari guide mein hai.

Criminal route khula rehta hai, aur complaint ko ek woman police officer ko record karna hota hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Courts ne 2024 mein poore hue sexual harassment trials mein se 41.9% mein conviction di, lekin 93.3% cases, kul 1,22,888, saal ke end par abhi pending the [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Jo joke tabhi chalta hai jab kamre mein ek insaan uncomfortable rahe, woh joke nahi hai. 1997 se uska ek legal naam hai.

Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.
